question: I don't think the two of them have interacted much, but what was Petra's first impression of Garfiel? If there was a little episode that suited the two of them, please share it!
answer: When Petra was practicing cooking, Garfiel was chosen as a taster, so the two of them became good friends. As Petra continues to improve her cooking skill for Subaru's sake, it makes Garfiel happy as well. They're close to the same age, too.
